datasets.name: Landslide4Sense (L4S) benchmark dataset
datasets.source: Institute of Advanced Research in Artificial Intelligence (IARAI)
datasets.verbatim: The data are accessible on Future Development Leaderboard for future evaluation at https://www.iarai.ac.at/landslide4sense/challenge/

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery
datasets.verbatim: The global objective is to build DL-based models for understanding the differentiating characteristics of landslides based on the provided optical digital elevation model (DEM) and slope layers from freely available satellite imagery acquired by Sentinel-2 sensors and ALOS PALSAR.

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR DEM and slope layers
datasets.verbatim: The Alaska Satellite Facility is one of the distributed active archive centers that provides high-resolution DEM from ALOS PALSAR at no cost to the user.

datasets.name: Google Earth images
datasets.verbatim: In the second step of our landslide annotation and image labeling procedure, a variety of further data sources were then used to visually correct landslide polygons, specifically Google Earth images

methods.name: Baseline U-Net
methods.summary: A U-Net semantic segmentation model implemented in PyTorch, consisting of an encoder-decoder architecture with 23 convolutional layers, used as a baseline for the competition.
methods.verbatim: We provided a simple baseline in our public GitHub repository prior to the start of the L4S competition.1 ... 1https://github.com/iarai/Landslide4Sense-2022

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense benchmark dataset is linked, and other input datasets are accessible via public providers. The custom baseline U-Net code is available via a provided GitHub repository link.
